 The Army Black Knights face the Tulsa Golden Hurricane Friday at 8:30 p.m. ET. The game will air on ESPN2, which you can stream free on DIRECTV . 
 Where to watch Army vs. Tulsa Football for free
 Today’s matchup: Army Black Knights (4-2, 3-1 AAC) vs. Tulsa Golden Hurricane (4-3, 1-2 AAC)
 When: Friday, Oct. 23, 8:30 p.m. ET/7:30 p.m. CT
 TV Channel: ESPN2
 Stream: DIRECTV (free trial) , FuboTV (free trial) , ESPN Unlimited , Hulu + Live TV

 Friday’s matchup between Army and Tulsa has plenty of weight in the American Conference race, especially for a Black Knights team trying to build momentum after its most explosive offensive performance of the season.
 Army enters at 4-2 overall and 3-1 in conference play after overpowering Florida Atlantic 56-24. Quarterback Cale Hellums was the engine of the offense, rushing for 195 yards and a career-high five touchdowns. The Black Knights piled up 479 rushing yards, averaged 8.0 yards per carry and scored on each of their first seven possessions.
 Now comes a very different challenge. Tulsa is 4-3 overall and 1-2 in conference play after rallying from an early 10-point deficit to beat Rice 38-17. The Golden Hurricane defense could be particularly important against Army’s run-heavy attack. Tulsa has forced at least one turnover in every game, producing 15 takeaways while committing only four turnovers itself.
 That makes ball security one of Friday’s biggest storylines. Army’s ground game can control the clock and wear down a defense, but Tulsa has consistently found ways to create extra possessions.
 There is also some revenge in the equation for Army. Tulsa stunned the Black Knights 26-25 last season, overcoming an 11-point fourth-quarter deficit.
 For Army, a win would keep it near the top of the American standings. For Tulsa, beating the Black Knights for a second straight year would provide another sign that the program is making progress under Tre Lamb.
